title: Iced Green Tea, Decaffeinated, Pre‑sweetened with Low‑Calorie Sweetener

content.title: About
content.content: This iced green tea is brewed, then cooled and sweetened with a low‑calorie sweetener. It retains the fresh, grassy flavor of green tea while being caffeine‑free, making it suitable for evening consumption.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, which have antioxidant properties.
Decaffeination is usually performed by steam processing, preserving most beneficial compounds.
Low‑calorie sweeteners such as stevia allow sweetness with minimal calories.
Iced tea is often served with a slice of lemon or a sprig of mint to enhance flavor.
In Japan, ready‑to‑drink cold green teas are a popular beverage.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Polyphenols in green tea help neutralize free radicals, supporting cellular health.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Regular green tea consumption is associated with improved lipid profiles and lower blood pressure.

items.title: Hydration aid
items.content: A caffeine‑free cold beverage contributes to fluid balance, especially in warm weather.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: Sweetened with a low‑calorie sweetener, the drink provides minimal calories, useful for weight management.

items.title: No nervous system stimulation
items.content: Absence of caffeine makes it safe for children, pregnant individuals, and those sensitive to stimulants.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to tea components.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Green tea contains oxalates, which in excess may contribute to kidney stone formation.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some individuals may experience digestive discomfort from certain low‑calorie sweeteners (e.g., maltitol).

content.title: How to Enjoy
content.content: Serve the iced tea chilled; add a lemon or lime wedge or a sprig of mint if desired. It pairs well with light snacks, fruit, and salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the beverage refrigerated at 0 °C–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Do not freeze, as it may affect texture.
